history.body: Hi, saw the Pearl Residences ad. We’re renting a small place now and looking for our first home. The 3 bedrooms caught my eye—would that suit a couple with a young child?

Yes, it could suit a couple with a young child. Phase 1 homes are 900 sq ft with 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony, so you’d have a separate room for your child and a third room that could offer flexibility as your needs change. I’d recommend viewing the layout in person to see how it feels for your family. Would you like help arranging a visit?
That sounds promising, especially having a separate room for our child. I’d like to arrange a visit and see how the layout feels for us. Could you also share the starting price?

Great — I’ll pass your request to a salesperson to contact you and arrange a visit; it won’t be booked until they confirm. As a starting reference, an eligible podium-blocked category is about RM302,000 after the listed rebate. That’s before any unit-specific car-park or add-on costs, so it isn’t an all-in quote.
